summary: USA Compression Partners, LP and its wholly owned subsidiary USA Compression Finance Corp. entered a purchase agreement on September 9, 2026 with J.P. Morgan Securities LLC, as representative of the initial purchasers, to issue $600.0 million aggregate principal of 6.750% senior notes due 2035 at par. The senior unsecured notes are guaranteed by existing and future restricted subsidiaries. Net proceeds of roughly $592.1 million will repay credit agreement borrowings and pay offering expenses. Closing is expected on or about September 18, 2026, subject to customary conditions. This is a routine private debt financing under Rule 144A/Regulation S, not a special situation; watch leverage and refinancing risk.
